related_questions.question: What can cancer patients get for free?

text_blocks.snippet: Cancer patients may be eligible for a variety of free or reduced-cost services and resources. These can include financial assistance for treatment costs, travel, housing, and other expenses. Additionally, some organizations offer free programs like counseling, support groups, and educational workshops. Cancer patients can also find free or discounted services related to transportation, lodging, and caregiving.
snippet_highlighted_words: financial assistance for treatment costs, travel, housing, and other expenses

list.title: Grants:
list.snippet: Organizations like the Cancer in the Family Relief Fund and the Kamm Cares Foundation offer grants to cover expenses like food, travel, and childcare.

list.title: Co-payment Assistance:
list.snippet: The CancerCare Co-Payment Assistance Foundation helps patients with out-of-pocket costs related to treatment.

list.title: Other Financial Aid:
list.snippet: Programs like the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) can help with home energy costs.

list.title: Transportation:
list.snippet: Organizations like the American Cancer Society and Mercy Medical Angels offer free or discounted transportation to appointments.

list.title: Lodging:
list.snippet: Several organizations can help with free or reduced-cost lodging for patients receiving treatment away from home.

list.title: Counseling and Support Groups:
list.snippet: CancerCare provides free professional support, including counseling, support groups, and educational workshops.

list.title: Care Packages:
list.snippet: Organizations like The Pablove Foundation offer free care packages.

list.title: Other Services:
list.snippet: Cleaning services, such as Cleaning for a Reason, are available for women undergoing treatment.
Dial 211 or visit www.211.org for information and referrals to local resources.

list.title: Online Directories:
list.snippet: Websites like Cancer Care News and CancerCare provide comprehensive lists of resources.

list.title: Local Chapters:
list.snippet: Contact local chapters of organizations like the American Cancer Society for information on local programs.
